thread:
Alex: (evening handoff) quick notes — what I did / blockers / today

Alex: What I did: handled regen p95 spike in prod-east, routed ~12% of traffic to small-v2 fallback, scaled router pool +2, added KV cache pressure metric alert. Deployed temp routing rule canary.

Alex: Blockers: persistent KV cache thrash on embed-fetchers causing OOM pods; need infra window to bump mem; also waiting on security sign-off to keep fallback model beyond 30m. Logs/snippet:
```bash
# check router pods
kubectl --context=prod-east get pods -l app=router -o wide
kubectl --context=prod-east logs -l app=router | grep "cache evict" | tail -n 20
```

OncallBot: alert: regen-service p95 spike in prod-east — 20:10 UTC — triggered autoscale. (alert id: A-9821)

Mira: saw the same. I checked traces, KV miss rate jumped to 23% at 20:08. Link: https://grafana.redwood/prod/regendash?panel=evictions

Mira: suggestion — temporarily reduce max_batch_size from 32->20 on embed workers to lower mem. Will open patch.

Samir: I pushed PR #4852 with the batch-size change and small telemetry. @Mira pls review, it's quick.

Lina: no other infra incidents. Cluster utilization in prod-east at 72% after scale up.

Priya: FYI on escalation — if evictions >30% for 15m, page infra-sre L2. Runbook snippet: keep fallback model, scale embeders, restart pod with diag env.

Alex: thanks — I'm OK keeping fallback for 2 hours if infra agrees. @Samir can you hold rollforward until Mira approves? I'll monitor p95 and eviction. Will update in 15m.

Mira: ack, reviewing PR now.

Samir: ack, will hold.

Lina: adding note to postmortem if we don't fix cache policy before midnight.

Alex: closing handoff — next check at +15m. channel for followups: #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
